/**

 * @description Deserializing untrusted data using pickle or other unsafe methods can lead to arbitrary code execution

 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("yaml").getMember(["load", "unsafe_load"]).getACall() or

/**
 * @name XML External Entity (XXE) injection (refined)
 * @description Parsing untrusted XML data with a vulnerable parser can lead to XXE.
 *              This query excludes the 'testing' directory.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/xxe-refined
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-611
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("etree").getMember("ElementTree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("lxml").getMember("etree").getMember(["parse", "fromstring", "XML"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("dom").getMember("minidom").getMember("parseString").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("xml").getMember("sax").getMember("parseString").getACall()
  )
  and not call.getLocation().getFile().getRelativePath().regexpMatch(".*testing/.*")
select call, "Potential XML parsing vulnerable to XXE."

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name ReDoS in regex
 * @description Vulnerability to Regular Expression Denial of Service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.TaintTracking
import semmle.python.Concepts
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "search", "match", "findall", "finditer", "split", "sub", "subn"]).getACall() and
  arg = call.getArg(0) and
  // Simple heuristic: look for nested quantifiers or overlapping repetitions which are common indicators of ReDoS
  // This is a very basic syntactic check on the string literal if possible
  exists(string s |
    s = arg.asExpr().(StrConst).getText() and
    (
      s.regexpMatch(".*\\(.+\\+\\)\\+.*") or
      s.regexpMatch(".*\\(.+\\*\\)\\*.*") or
      s.regexpMatch(".*\\(.+\\+\\)\\*.*") or
      s.regexpMatch(".*\\(.+\\*\\)\\+.*") or
      s.regexpMatch(".*\\{\\d+,\\}.*\\{\\d+,\\}.*")
    )
  )
select call, "Potential ReDoS vulnerability in regex: " + arg.asExpr().(StrConst).getText()
